---
title: Parental leave
department: people
status: current
---
Northwind offers the same parental leave entitlement to every parent regardless
of gender, whether the child arrives by birth, adoption or surrogacy. There is no
primary or secondary carer distinction, because that distinction pushes couples
into roles the company has no business assigning.

The entitlement is twenty six weeks at full pay, available to any employee with
twelve months of continuous service at the expected date of arrival. Employees
below twelve months receive the statutory entitlement for their country plus a
company top up to eighty percent of pay for the first twelve weeks.

Leave may be taken in up to three separate blocks within the first two years. A
block must be at least two consecutive weeks. Blocks are requested through the
people portal with eight weeks notice, and the manager approves the timing rather
than the entitlement itself.

A phased return is available for the first eight weeks back, at four days paid as
five. The phased return is requested at the same time as the leave and does not
consume any part of the twenty six week entitlement.

Employees on parental leave keep their equipment, their accounts and their access
to internal channels. Nobody is removed from a team channel while on leave. A
manager who backfills the role does so on a stated end date so the returning
employee is not quietly displaced.

Pay reviews and bonus calculations treat time on parental leave as time worked.
An employee on leave during a review cycle receives the review, and the bonus is
calculated on the full period rather than pro rated.

Anyone experiencing pregnancy loss is entitled to paid compassionate leave with
no minimum service and no requirement to explain the circumstances to a manager.
